title: Heavenly Fate Reversal
next_chapter_hook: Just as the rift split open, countless ancient runes surged forth like a tide—that was the true content of the Fourth Layer Seal of the Tianji Record, sealed away for ten thousand years—and the gaze of Heavenly Dao was slowly descending from the other side of that crack.

text.content: Within the Tianqing Sect Council Hall, the oppressive atmosphere felt like the stifling heat before a storm. Han Lie's fists clenched so tight they creaked, blue veins snaking across his knuckles like earthworms, and his gaze—those eyes that had once only held battle and victory—was now locked tightly on Chen Ji's serene face, as if wanting to burn through that expression of calm that bordered on mockery.

Chen Ji sat at the lowest seat, his posture humble as a truly penitent Servant Disciple awaiting punishment. Yet within his sleeve, his fingertips drummed lightly against his hand—that habit of his when thinking—three long beats, two short, like a private code only he could understand. He knew what was churning in Han Lie's mind at this moment: fury, resentment, the humiliation of being fooled, and an almost frantic urge to regain lost face.

「Chen Ji!」 Han Lie finally spoke, his voice hoarse as if scraped from the depths of his throat. 「You'd better give me an explanation.」 Behind him, the Xuanwu Sect guards had quietly spread out, subtly blocking every exit of the council hall. This was the Xuanwu Sect's usual pressure tactic—they never trusted words, only fists and numbers.

dialogue.content: 「What do you mean, Senior Brother Han?」 Chen Ji raised his head, his eyes full of fear. 「I merely followed sect rules and truthfully reported the intelligence on border anomalies. Could that be wrong?」 His voice trembled slightly, perfectly displaying the nervousness and innocence of someone being questioned.

text.content: This act only made Han Lie's teeth itch. He had seen too many such hypocritical gentlemen—polite on the surface, stabbing in the back—and Chen Ji was undoubtedly the most detestable one he'd ever encountered. The intelligence from three days ago was clearly guided by Chen Ji to lead him to that valley, and the ambush he encountered there confirmed that there was a mole within the Xuanwu Sect—and that 'intelligence' was handed over personally by Chen Ji.

The council hall fell into dead silence. The Tianqing Sect elders exchanged uncertain glances—they could clearly see the undercurrents behind this confrontation, but no one was willing to step forward. After all, on one side was the number one genius of the Xuanwu Sect, and on the other was the most insignificant Servant Disciple in the sect—anyone would choose to protect themselves.

However, at this moment, Chen Ji felt a burning sensation in his chest. It was the warning from the Tianji Record Fragment—a stirring from deep within his bloodline, as if something long dormant was awakening. His pupils slightly narrowed, alarm bells ringing in his heart. According to Mo Xiansheng, when the Heavenly Fate Value drops to a certain critical point, the ancient blood within the body will automatically activate to prevent the bearer's death.

He quietly sent a thread of divine consciousness into his body, only to see the Tianji Record floating in the depths of his Mental Sea, radiating a cold, eerie glow. And on the Fourth Layer Seal of the Tianji Record, a crack so fine it was almost invisible was slowly spreading. Though tiny, it emanated a breath-taking aura—a power fluctuation that transcended his current level of understanding.

dialogue.content: (The Fourth Layer of the Tianji Record... finally showing signs?) He murmured in his heart, his lips unconsciously curving slightly upward. Mo Xiansheng had said that loosening the Fourth Layer Seal required two conditions: first, the Heavenly Fate Value touching the threshold of life and death; second, the bearer facing a life-threatening crisis. And now, both conditions seemed to be approaching their critical point.

choice.prompt: Han Lie presses forward relentlessly, the Tianqing Sect elders stand by indifferently, and your Heavenly Fate Value is touching the limit—how will you deal with this crisis?

choices.text: Endure and Feign Weakness, Lure the Enemy Deeper
choices.description: Continue to display atrash posture, provoking Han Lie into more extreme actions, laying the groundwork for a counterattack.
choices.risk_hint: If Heavenly Fate Value continues to drop, bloodline loss of control may be exposed early

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his eyes, his voice barely a whisper: 「If Senior Brother Han thinks I was wrong, I'm willing to accept any punishment...」 As he spoke, his body actually hunched slightly, perfectly mimicking someone whose courage had been shattered. However, the moment he lowered his head, a sharp gleam flashed in his eyes—that was the look a hunter has when watching prey step into a trap.

choices.description: Stop suppressing the surging bloodline power within, let the ancient potential release completely, and crush Han Lie's provocation with absolute strength.
choices.visible_reward: Transcendent God Middle Stage Breakthrough, Cracks Appearing on Tianji Record Fourth Layer Seal
choices.risk_hint: The Eye of Heavenly Dao May Detect the Power Fluctuation

text.content: Chen Ji slowly rose to his feet, his movements gentle as a breeze brushing across water. Yet the moment he straightened his body, an invisible pressure burst forth from him. It was power from the depths of his bloodline, the ancient will carried by the Tianji Record Fragment, his true strength suppressed for far too long. The air in the hall instantly froze, and everyone involuntarily held their breath under this pressure.

Han Lie clearly hadn't anticipated this. His fist froze mid-air, and the flames of rage in his eyes were instantly replaced by shock. As the number one genius of the Xuanwu Sect, his perception of power was keener than anyone's—the aura emanating from Chen Ji at this moment clearly surpassed any Transcendent God Stage Initial cultivator he had ever known.

"This... this is impossible!" Han Lie's voice trembled, the arrogance and fury on his face collapsing completely in this moment, replaced by a terrified bewilderment. "How could a servant disciple..." His words cut off abruptly, because at that moment, Chen Ji raised his gaze and met his eyes. There was no anger in those eyes, no mockery, only a chilling calm—a calm that only appears when one looks down upon ants.

Chen Ji felt the surging power within his body, his lips curving slightly upward. Mid Transformation God Stage—he had finally crossed this threshold. Countless days and nights of忍, countless times of playing the pig to eat the tiger, countless times watching enemies slip through his fingers yet having to let them go—all the憋屈 found its reward in this moment. Yet he knew it was far from enough.

The fourth layer seal of the Tianji Record hummed in his Mental Sea, the crack expanding visibly to the naked eye. Through the fissure, he glimpsed certain visions—countless intertwined threads of fate, the运作 of the most secretive laws between heaven and earth, the ultimate secrets even the Heavenly Dao's Eye could not fully peer into. However, just as he tried to see more clearly, a cold gaze suddenly descended upon him.

It was the gaze of the Heavenly Dao's Eye. Every hair on Chen Ji's body stood on end, a primal fear from the depths of his instincts seized his heart. This was no ordinary gaze, but something transcending his cognitive scope, watching him from the Void—as if saying: "You think you've broken free from the chess game, but you merely jumped from a small chessboard into a larger one."

Yet Chen Ji merely smiled lightly. That smile held no fear, only a nearly manic obsession. He had walked too far on this path, seen too many ants crushed by fate. He refused to become one of them, so he must become more terrifying than fate itself.

"Break Game Eye... Complete Form." He murmured, his pupils constricting sharply. An unprecedented power burst from within him—the primal force leaking through the loosened fourth seal of the Tianji Record. The air within the Council Hall twisted completely, and everyone witnessed a scene they would never forget—within Chen Ji's eyes, the sun, moon and stars slowly revolved.

dialogue.content: "Senior Brother Han," Chen Ji's voice was as calm as hidden currents in an abyss, "Are you certain you wish to be my enemy?" He didn't动用 any Spiritual Energy fluctuation, didn't释放 any momentum pressure, simply asked this single question. Yet this one sentence made Han Lie, the Xuanwu Sect's foremost genius, retreat three steps.

text.content: In the Break Game Eye's Complete Form, Chen Ji saw everything. He saw Han Lie would burst forward in three breaths, be repelled by the sect-protecting formation, lose all face before the Tianqing Sect elders. He saw the Xuanwu Sect guards blocking the exits would receive urgent sect orders and flee in panic after one incense stick's time. He saw further—Ling Yuan was opening his eyes in some secret chamber, a meaningful smile curling at the corner of his lips.

choice.prompt: The Break Game Eye reveals its Complete Form, the Heavenly Dao's Eye's gaze prickles like thorns on the back—you see one breath into the future, yet sense an even more terrifying窥探. How will you wield this power?

choices.text: Follow the momentum, intimidate Han Lie
choices.description: Utilize the Break Game Eye's foresight to precisely predict Han Lie's every move, crushing him with absolute dominance until he retreats.
choices.visible_cost: Expose part of the Break Game Eye's abilities
choices.visible_reward: Han Lie loses all face, Xuanwu Sect temporarily retreats
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Dao's Eye's gaze will intensify

text.content: Chen Ji's figure suddenly blurred in everyone's eyes, as if merging with the air. When Han Lie roared and charged forward, his fist pierced through Chen Ji's afterimage, striking empty air. The real Chen Ji had somehow appeared behind Han Lie, his fingers gently touching the nape of the latter's neck.

choices.text: Guide secretly, kill with a borrowed knife
choices.description: Don't strike directly, but use the Break Game Eye to foresee Han Lie's wretched downfall, adding fuel to the fire in the shadows, letting him walk into the abyss himself.
choices.visible_reward: Han Lie steps into a bigger trap unknowingly
choices.risk_hint: Requires precise control of the situation's trajectory

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his eyes, seemingly bowing his head in surrender, but in truth was rapidly calculating every subsequent move within his Mental Sea. The visions from the Break Game Eye flickered through his mind like a carousel—Han Lie would become more arrogant due to his示弱, would do even more excessive things in Tianqing Sect, would正好 bump into the arriving Ling Yuan... everything was under his control.

Yet regardless of which choice, Chen Ji never forgot that cold gaze. The Heavenly Dao's Eye—that ultimate existence standing above all chess players, was observing this闹剧 in a way surpassing his comprehension. What was it waiting for? What did it expect? Had it long foreseen everything today?

These thoughts flashed by in an instant. Chen Ji knew this wasn't the time to contemplate such matters. He needed to survive, needed to grow stronger, needed to collect enough Tianji Record fragments until one day he could face that lofty existence directly. Until then, the only thing he could do was continue playing—regardless of whether he found himself on the chessboard or as a chess player.

The fourth layer seal of the Tianji Record emitted a low rumble in his Mental Sea, the crack having spread to one-third of the entire seal. Through those countless dense fissures, Chen Ji saw myriad flowing runes, felt a power beyond his current comprehension awakening. This was the final legacy left by the true master of the Tianji Record—or rather, the final curse.

dialogue.content: (Fourth layer... what exactly lies within?) He asked in his heart, yet expected no answer. Mo Xiansheng had said that each layer of the Tianji Record's seal corresponds to a dust-covered truth, and he needed to personally uncover these truths at the appropriate moment. Acting too hastily would only be devoured by the backlash.

text.content: Yet at this moment, he couldn't resist extending his spiritual sense toward that rift. The moment they touched, a blurred image flooded into his mind—an ancient altar, upon which lay a human-shaped silhouette, and in the chest of that silhouette, an eye was slowly opening. Within that eye's pupil, the laws governing heaven and earth's operations were reflected, as were the countless fates rising, falling, transforming and concluding.

Th-that... is that the本体 of the Heavenly Secret Eye? Chen Ji's spiritual sense abruptly withdrew, and a layer of fine cold sweat broke out on his forehead. He finally understood why Mo Xiansheng's tone carried a barely perceptible tremor whenever he mentioned that existence. It was no ordinary enemy—it was an ultimate existence standing above the laws of heaven and earth, the final destination of all seers—or rather, the final tomb.

Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcibly suppressing those chaotic thoughts. No matter how terrifying the Heavenly Secret Eye was, that was a matter for later. Right now, he had more pressing enemies to deal with. Han Lie's face had twisted with rage, the Xuanwu Sect guards were stirring restlessly, and those Tianqing Sect elders still maintained their silence.

"Chen Ji!" Han Lie's voice rang out like a beast's roar. "Don't think you can intimidate me with some demonic technique! Today, I'll see for myself just how much of your Transformation God Middle Stage cultivation is real!" With that, the spiritual energy around him swept forth like a storm, as if determined to fight Chen Ji to the death.

However, at this moment, hurried footsteps came from outside the hall. A Tianqing Sect disciple stumbled in, his face pale as paper: "Bad news! Lin-Lin Sect Master has emerged from seclusion! He says he'll personally handle today's matter!" At these words, everyone in the hall froze. Han Lie's expression instantly became complex—rage, unwillingness, wariness, all sorts of emotions interweaving.

Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, the images from his Foresight Eye automatically calculating in his mind. Lin Yuan's choice to emerge at this moment was no coincidence—was he here to watch the show, or to close the net? Or had he already sensed something? Whatever the answer, Chen Ji knew the real game had just begun.

The fourth seal of the Tianji Record quivered slightly in his Mental Sea, and that crack seemed to have expanded a fraction more. Through the fissure, he vaguely heard a sound—ancient calling, awakening memories buried in dust, a will dormant for ten thousand years slowly opening its eyes. The person it had been waiting for had finally arrived.

At that moment, an aged yet imposing voice came from outside the hall: "Let this old man see who dares to act so recklessly on my Tianqing Sect's territory." As the voice fell, the hall doors slowly opened, and a withered yet astonishingly pressuring figure appeared at the threshold. Lin Yuan—this old fox hidden in the shadows controlling everything—had finally bared his fangs.

Chen Ji's and Lin Yuan's gazes met in the air, as if silent sparks were flying. Chen Ji slightly bowed in a gesture of respect, his manner impeccable: "Disciple Chen Ji greets the Sect Master." However, deep in his heart, the Foresight Eye was operating frantically, dissecting and analyzing every subtle movement of the old man before him, searching for weaknesses and flaws.

dialogue.content: "Rise." Lin Yuan's gaze lingered on Chen Ji for a moment, a meaningful light flickering in his eyes. "This old man has heard that today's matter involves you?" His tone was calm, yet carried an irresistible pressure, as if he could crush this ant before him into dust at any moment.

text.content: Just as Chen Ji was about to answer, the fourth seal of the Tianji Record suddenly violently trembled. The crack expanded abruptly, and countless ancient runes surged from the fissure like a tide, forming a blurred image in his Mental Sea—it was Lin Yuan's memory fragment, a secret he had hidden for decades, an unknown connection between him and the Heavenly Secret Eye.

Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. The Heavenly Secret Eye... Lin Yuan was also connected to that existence! His mind raced rapidly, and countless fragments connected into a line at this moment—why had the Tianji Record skipped Lin Yuan and choose Chen Xuan back then? Why was Lin Yuan's obsession with the Tianji Record so deep? Why would he emerge at this exact moment? All the answers seemed to point in the same direction.

choice.prompt: The crack in the fourth seal of the Tianji Record exposed Lin Yuan's connection to the Heavenly Secret Eye—this fragment of a ten-thousand-year secret makes your heart pound. How will you respond before Lin Yuan?

choices.description: Directly question Lin Yuan's relationship with the Heavenly Secret Eye, expose the secret he has hidden for years on the spot, and push him to the opposing side of all forces.
choices.visible_cost: Make an enemy of the strongest antagonist
choices.visible_reward: Disrupt all of Lin Yuan's schemes
choices.risk_hint: Without sufficient strength to support you, you may be killed on the spot

text.content: Chen Ji stared directly into Lin Yuan's eyes, the corner of his mouth suddenly curving into a meaningful smile: "Sect Master, this disciple dares to ask—what is your relationship with the Heavenly Secret Eye?" The moment these words fell, silence like death descended over the hall. A nearly imperceptible stiffness flickered across Lin Yuan's face, then was replaced by even deeper emotions.

choices.text: Endure silently, scheme in the shadows
choices.description: Buried this discovery deep in your heart, continue playing the role of thetrash disciple, secretly gather more evidence, and wait for the perfect moment for a killing blow.
choices.risk_hint: Lin Yuan may have already sensed your abnormality
choices.process_label: endure hardship, wait forthe right moment

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his eyes, his voice carrying恰到好处的 fear: "This disciple is terrified, merely reporting intelligence truthfully, with absolutely no intention of offending the Sect Master..." His words were humble and appropriate, betraying no flaws. However, deep in his Mental Sea, the Foresight Eye had already recorded every micro-expression of Lin Yuan, waiting for future analysis.

Ling Yuan cast a deep glance at Chen Ji, as if those turbid old eyes held countless words unspoken. He did not answer Chen Ji's question, merely waving his hand lightly: 'Today's matter ends here. Han Lie, take your people back to the Xuanwu Sect, and tell your sect master that I will personally pay a visit another day.' His voice was calm, yet carried an unquestionable authority.

Han Lie wanted to say something more, but under Ling Yuan's gaze, he swallowed his words forcefully. He shot Chen Ji a fierce glare and swept away with his sleeves. Before leaving, his voice drifted from outside the hall: 'Chen Ji, remember this! The humiliation of today, I, Han Lie, will repay a hundredfold someday!' His footsteps faded into the distance, yet carried an undertone of unwillingness and spite.

The atmosphere in the hall gradually eased. The elders of the Tianqing Sect took their leave one after another, and as they departed, their gazes toward Chen Ji held deeper, more meaningful glances - this servant disciple who had always been regarded as worthless seemed not as simple as they'd imagined. Ling Yuan remained standing in place, his gaze never leaving Chen Ji.

'You did well.' Ling Yuan suddenly spoke, his voice revealing neither joy nor anger, 'Better than I anticipated... far better.' His words seemed to carry deeper implications, setting alarm bells ringing in Chen Ji's heart. How much did this old man actually know? Had he already sensed the existence of the Tianji Record?

dialogue.content: 'Master's praise is too generous, this disciple does not deserve such honor.' Chen Ji bowed, his posture still respectful as that of a true servant disciple. However, in the instant he lowered his head, Ling Yuan suddenly reached out, a withered hand as thin as firewood gently pressing against his scalp.

text.content: A pure and powerful spiritual energy instantly flooded into Chen Ji's body, carrying within it a scent Chen Ji had never felt before - that was a level surpassing the Transformation God realm, a half-step Great Ascension on the verge of touching the other shore! Every hair on Chen Ji's body stood on end, the Break Pattern Eyecrazed运转, foreseeing all that might happen next.

Yet the visions it foresaw were a blur. Ling Yuan's spiritual energy wandered through Chen Ji's body, as if searching for something, but never touched the core of the Tianji Record. That ancient seal from distant times concealed the existence of the Tianji Record so tightly that even a half-step Great Ascension powerhouse like Ling Yuan could not glimpse a single detail.

'Strange...' Ling Yuan's brow slightly furrowed. His hand lingered atop Chen Ji's head for a moment before slowly withdrawing, 'There is indeed something in your body, but this old man cannot see through it.' His tone carried a hint of confusion, soon replaced by deeper emotions, 'Very well, the time is not yet right. Forcing it serves no purpose.'

Chen Ji dared not relax in the slightest, still maintaining his bowed posture. Yet in the depths of his heart, mighty waves were churning. Although Ling Yuan's probe had been blocked by the Tianji Record's seal, it had confirmed one terrifying fact - Ling Yuan was indeed searching for the Tianji Record, and his method of searching was identical to the gaze of the Heavenly Dao's Eye.

'Go.' Ling Yuan waved his hand, 'Cultivate diligently, do not disappoint... your talent.' His words carried profound meaning, and something indecipherable flickered in his gaze. As Chen Ji turned to leave, what he did not know was that behind him, those turbid old eyes were glinting with a dangerous light.

Stepping out of the Council Hall, Chen Ji realized his back was soaked with cold sweat. Although Ling Yuan's probe had been blocked by the Tianji Record's seal, it had exposed a terrifying truth - he had become Ling Yuan's target, the kind of target receiving key attention. What kind of game was this old fox, who had hidden for decades, actually plotting?

Chen Ji took a deep breath and raised his head to gaze at the azure sky above the Tianqing Sect. The lingering resonance of the Break Pattern Eye had not yet fully faded. In his vision, he could faintly see threads invisible to the naked eye - those were the threads of destiny, the shackles of karma, the invisible lines connecting every piece on the board. And at the end of those threads, a enormous eye was slowly opening, coldly gazing upon all things in this world.

The Heavenly Dao's Eye. It was everywhere, it knew everything, and it regarded every self-proclaimed chess master as a piece to be manipulated. Chen Ji had once believed he was breaking the局, not knowing he had merely jumped from a small chessboard into a larger one. But so what? As long as he was alive, as long as the Tianji Record remained, he still had a chance to turn the tables.

Just then, the fourth layer of the Tianji Record's seal trembled once more. The crack had spread to half of the seal. Through the fissure, Chen Ji finally saw part of the contents within - ancient text recording the original purpose of the Tianji Record's creation, and the ten-thousand-year karmic entanglement between it and the Heavenly Dao's Eye.

'The Tianji Record is an instrument forged by those who defy heaven, to peer into heavenly secrets, break the heavenly way, and seize heavenly fate...' Chen Ji silently recited the passage in his heart, each character exploding like thunderclaps in his mind. So that was it. The purpose of the Tianji Record's existence had always been to oppose heaven - and its ultimate goal was to completely destroy that eye gazing down from on high.

However, the text ended abruptly there. The remaining content was blocked by deeper seals, and only when the fourth layer was completely unsealed could one continue reading. Chen Ji knew the road ahead was still long, the enemy still powerful, and the only thing he could do now was to continue growing stronger, continue plotting, until one day he could personally uncover all the truths.

The evening breeze of the Tianqing Sect blew past, carrying a chill. Chen Ji turned to gaze toward the Council Hall, his eyes flickering with a resolute light. Ling Yuan's probe today, although failing to uncover the Tianji Record, had also exposed him to greater danger. From now on, he must be more cautious, more restrained, to find a sliver of survival under the gaze of that omnipresent eye.

In a certain corner of the Tianqing Sect, in a sealed chamber usually locked tight, Ling Yuan sat cross-legged on a meditation cushion. Before him floated an ancient bronze mirror, reflecting a enormous eye - that eye was cold, majestic, gazing down from on high as if surveying all living beings.

dialogue.content: 'He has appeared.' Ling Yuan's voice was low and hoarse, 'The one you have waited ten thousand years for... has finally appeared.' The eye in the mirror seemed to respond, an无声的fluctuation transmitting from it, causing Ling Yuan's lips to curl into a meaningful smile.

text.content: 'Chen Xuan's inheritor, the new master of the Tianji Record...' Ling Yuan murmured, his fingers gently tapping the ground, 'Interesting, very interesting. Back then Chen Xuan snatched the Tianji Record from my hands. Now, how will his successor face me?' His laughter echoed in the chamber, carrying a bone-chilling coldness.

In the more distant Void depths, the本体 of the Heavenly Dao's Eye was slowly turning. It sensed the loosening of the Tianji Record's fourth seal, sensed that this ant-like human was touching the secrets it did not wish others to know. Yet it felt no anger, made no intervention - because everything was within its control.

The creators of the Tianji Record thought they could defy fate and change destiny, not knowing they had merely fallen into another, deeper trap. The so-called 'breaking the局' was merely a breaking of the局 it permitted; the so-called 'rebellion' was merely a rebellion it designed. And now, the new inheritor was walking along the footsteps of predecessors, step by step toward the endgame it had prepared for him.

Yet it had not anticipated that in that decrepit servant quarters of the Tianqing Sect, Chen Ji was cradling an oil lamp, and by that dim yellowish light, writing rows of symbols only he could understand on paper. Those were partial contents leaked from the Tianji Record's fourth seal, his beginning of opposing the heavenly way, and another crucial piece falling into the chess game he had been weaving for years.

'The connection between Ling Yuan and the Heavenly Dao's Eye...' Chen Ji drew a complex diagram on paper, 'If this can be proven, it can be used as leverage at a critical moment. Or...' His brush tip paused on the paper for an instant, then sketched a new symbol, 'Or let him believe I still don't know, so as to catch him off guard at a critical moment.'

Outside the window, the night was deep, the star river hidden behind clouds. Chen Ji put down his brush and raised his head to gaze at the sky beyond the window. The lingering resonance of the Break Pattern Eye allowed him to see what ordinary people could not - those threads of destiny, those shackles of karma, those invisible lines connecting everyone together. And at the end of those threads, he saw the figure of his sister Chen Nian - that girl taken away by the Holy Sect, used as a 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key'.

"Little Nian..." Chen Ji's voice was low and gentle, a side he rarely showed. "Wait a little longer for me. I will definitely come to save you." His fingers gently traced the cover of the Tianji Record, where there was a pattern he had never noticed before—the pattern looked like a closed eye, somewhat similar to the Heavenly Eye, yet entirely different.

Just at this moment, the Tianji Record suddenly emitted a faint glow. That was energy leaking from the widening crack in the Fourth Layer Seal, weak yet containing a force that made Chen Ji's heart tremble. He lowered his gaze to the cover, only to see that pattern slowly opening—not the Heavenly Eye, but another eye born alongside the Tianji Record.

"I've finally been waiting for you." An old and weary voice emerged from that eye. "Chen Xuan's successor... I've been waiting for you for so long." Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply—that was Mo Xiansheng's voice—no, not Mo Xiansheng, but an existence far more ancient. Mo Xiansheng was merely the guardian of the Tianji Record's first page, but the master of this eye... was the will remnant left by the Tianji Record's true creator.

"You are..." Chen Ji's voice trembled slightly, the first time he had ever lost his composure so thoroughly. Yet that eye simply watched him silently, its gaze holding no emotionalfluctuation, only a weariness and anticipation spanning ten thousand years. "There is not much time left," it said. "The Fourth Layer Seal has begun to loosen, which means the Heavenly Eye's gaze will grow stronger. You must... become strong enough before then."

Chen Ji took a deep breath, suppressing the shock and excitement in his heart. His voice returned to calm: "What do I need to do?" The eye fell silent for a moment, then said: "The Tianji Record has nine layers of seals, each corresponding to a segment of buried truth. You have uncovered one quarter... but this is merely the beginning."

"The Heavenly Eye views you as a chess piece because it believes you are controllable." A hint of sarcasm laced the eye's voice. "But what it doesn't know is that the Tianji Record's creator buried the seed to reverse fate from the very start. That seed... is yourself."

Chen Ji listened quietly, his mind racing at lightning speed. Mo Xiansheng had once said that the complete truth of the Tianji Record could only be revealed after the Tianji Record was fully unsealed. And now, this eye from ten thousand years ago seemed intent on telling him something in advance—was this an opportunity, or another trap?

"I know what you're thinking." The eye seemed to see through his doubts. "You're wondering if I am also a chess piece of the Heavenly Eye." A hint of bitterness colored its voice. "No... I am merely a failure. Ten thousand years ago, I attempted to use the Tianji Record against that existence, only to be counteracted by it in the end. What remains now is only this wisp of surviving will."

"But I am different from you." The eye gazed directly at Chen Ji. "You have no retreat, no choices. The only thing you can do is walk the path we have walked, continuing forward. Until one day... you can go further than we ever could." Its voice gradually grew fainter, as if it might dissipate into the void at any moment.

"Wait!" Chen Ji urgently spoke up. "What exactly is hidden in the Fourth Layer Seal? What is the Heavenly Eye's true purpose? What connection does my sister Chen Nian have with all this?" Yet the eye merely closed slowly, its voice growing fainter and fainter: "The answers... are all within the seals... the Fourth Layer... is merely the beginning..."

The light dissipated, and everything fell silent. Chen Ji lowered his gaze to the Tianji Record's cover—the eye had completely vanished, as if it had never existed. Yet he knew it was no illusion—that was a side of the Tianji Record he had never touched, the true core hidden within the inheritance he had received.

The crack in the Tianji Record's Fourth Layer Seal flickered with a faint glow under the moonlight—that was the bridge connecting past and future, the harbinger of truths buried for ten thousand years beginning to surface. Chen Ji tucked the Tianji Record into his chest, his gaze casting toward the distant horizon—there awaited Han Lie's hatred, Ling Yuan's scheming, the Heavenly Eye's gaze, and his long-lost sister Chen Nian.

"No matter how perilous the path ahead..." Chen Ji murmured softly, his voice carrying unwavering resolve. "I will walk it." He turned and walked into the room, picking up the pen and paper on the table, continuing to paint his chess game. The Heavenly Eye wanted to treat him as a chess piece? Then he would become a piece that leaps off the chessboard, using heaven and earth as the board and all living beings as pieces, weaving an ultimate chess game that even heaven could not see through.

The moment his pen touched the paper, the Tianji Record suddenly shook violently. The crack on the Fourth Layer Seal abruptly expanded at this instant, countless ancient runes gushing forth like a tide, forming a clear image within Chen Ji's Mental Sea—a secret place, a sealed altar from ten thousand years ago, and the human-shaped outline lying upon it slowly opening its eyes.

That eye was exactly the same as the one Chen Ji had seen in the crack—cold, authoritative, high and mighty, yet carrying an eerie sense of familiarity. It seemed to be gazing directly at Chen Ji's soul through the Tianji Record's seal. In that moment, Chen Ji felt a bone-deep chill, as if something was attempting to invade his Mental Sea.

Yet just as that force was about to touch his soul, the Tianji Record's Fourth Layer Seal suddenly erupted with brilliant light, forcibly repelling the invading force. Chen Ji's eyes snapped open, and he discovered his forehead was already covered in cold sweat. On the Tianji Record's cover, that crack had expanded to fully one-third of the cover.

Through that crack, Chen Ji finally saw part of the contents within the Fourth Layer Seal—a record about the Tianji Record's creator, a secret about the Heavenly Eye's origin, and most importantly, a prophecy about the "Heavenly Fate Lock-Key." And among those words, he saw a name that made his heart stop—Chen Nian.

"The Heavenly Fate Lock-Key is the crystallization of a bloodline that defies heaven. It can unlock the Tianji Record's highest seal, and can also... completely destroy the Heavenly Eye." Chen Ji read word by word, each character exploding like thunder in his mind. Chen Nian—his sister—was actually the legendary Heavenly Fate Lock-Key, the key that could completely end the Heavenly Eye!

What did this mean? The Holy Sect taking Chen Nian was not coincidence, but an arrangement of the Heavenly Eye? Or was someone using Chen Nian to threaten him? Whichever possibility it was, Chen Ji felt an unprecedented sense of crisis. He must find Chen Nian as quickly as possible, rescue her from that abyss before the Heavenly Eye could use her.

Yet he knew this was not yet the time. His strength was still too weak, his arrangements were not complete enough, he did not yet have sufficient leverage to face the Heavenly Eye directly. He must continue to endure, continue to grow stronger, continue weaving that chess game that could even deceive heaven. Until one day, he could personally rescue Chen Nian from that cage, personally end that高高在上的眼睛.

Outside the window, the eastern sky had begun to lighten. Chen Ji closed the Tianji Record and stood up. Another new day, another new game of power. His eyes burned with a fierce light—that was the flame of revenge, the obsession of protection, and the determination to oppose heaven's way.

The morning bells of the Tianqing Sect rang悠悠, startling the birds across the mountains. Chen Ji pushed open his door, facing the rising sun, breathing deeply. He felt the power within him surging more vigorously than yesterday, a faint smile curving his lips. Half-Step Transcendent Realm, complete Form of the Break Game Eye, crack in the Tianji Record's Fourth Layer Seal... he had drawn closer to that goal once more.

In a corner of the Tianqing Sect, Su Qingyao stood before her window, gazing distractedly in the direction of Chen Ji's residence. Everything that had happened in the Council Hall yesterday, she had seen it all. That servant disciple she had always regarded as worthless actually harbored such terrifying strength—and she, had never noticed it at all.

"Chen Ji..." Su Qingyao murmured softly, complex emotions flickering in her eyes. Three times now, she had come infinitely close to the truth three times, and three times he had resolved it. How many secrets was he still hiding now? She didn't know. But there was one thing she knew for certain—regardless of whether Chen Ji was enemy or ally, she had to find out.

And in an even more distant place, Ye Qing was leading the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path's forces, quietly approaching. She had received the message Chen Ji had transmitted through special channels—the Tianqing Sect's internal upheaval was imminent, this was the opportunity she had been waiting for. Yet what she didn't know was that while Chen Ji had sent her a message, he had also transmitted another piece of intelligence to Ling Yuan.

Killing three birds with one stone. Chen Ji murmured in his heart. Han Lie had already been provoked by him and would surely stir up trouble in the Xuanwu Sect, buying him more time; Ling Yuan, despite his deep scheming, did not know that he had long since learned of that earth-shaking secret; and Ye Qing's Holy Sect of the Demonic Path was the key piece he would use to disrupt the situation.

'Ling Yuan has a connection with the Eye of Heavenly Dao... this is an unexpected gain.' Chen Ji calculated in his heart, 'If I can make good use of this, I can make him hesitate at a crucial moment. Even...' A sharp light flickered in his eyes, 'I can even make him a pioneer in opposing the Eye of Heavenly Dao.'

However, he knew that all of this required time. Although cracks had appeared in the fourth layer of the Tianji Record's seal, completely unsealing it required more Heavenly Fate Value and greater Strength. According to Mo Xiansheng's words, breaking through each layer of sealing required crossing an enormous threshold, and his current strength was far from sufficient.

'But...' Chen Ji lowered his head to look at his own hands, feeling the more refined spiritual energy in his body compared to yesterday, 'From now on, everything will be different.' A confident smile curved his lips—the smile a hunter has when prey steps into a trap, the smile a chess player has before placing a piece.

Above the Tianqing Sect, the morning sun rose higher and higher, golden light spilling across the entire Sect Gate. Chen Ji stood in the morning light, his figure straight as a pine, his eyes deep as an abyss. From the outside, he was still that most inconspicuous Servant Disciple, humble, timid, with no presence at all. But only he knew that beneath that skin lay power enough to shake heaven and earth.

The fourth layer of the Tianji Record's seal grew slightly warm against his chest, the crack faintly visible under the sunlight. Through the gap, Chen Ji could vaguely see the runes inside slowly circulating, as if telling a story sealed for ten thousand years. It was a story of creation and destruction, of rebellion and suppression, of an existence like an ant attempting to shake the Heavenly Dao.

And now, he had become the protagonist of that story. Chen Ji took a deep breath and walked toward his battlefield. He did not know how many dangers, how many conspiracies, how many malicious gazes from the Eye of Heavenly Dao awaited him ahead. But he knew that as long as the Tianji Record remained in his hand, as long as he had breath left in his body, he would never give up.

'The Eye of Heavenly Dao...' Chen Ji silently念着着这个名字 in his heart, his eyes burning with raging fighting spirit, 'You treat me as a chess piece, not knowing I long ago saw through your chess game. One day, I will let you know what true 'defying destiny' means!'

The morning wind brushed past, stirring his robes. Tianqing Sect disciples walked out of their rooms one after another, beginning their cultivation for a new day. No one noticed the Servant Disciple walking among the crowd, nor did anyone know that the Tianji Record in his arms was awakening bit by bit. That was power enough to change the entire cultivation world's landscape, the ultimate trump card to oppose the Heavenly Dao's will.

Deep beneath the Tianqing Sect, in a chamber sealed for who knows how many ages, an existence that had been slumbering suddenly opened its eyes. It sensed the disturbance in the fourth layer of the Tianji Record's seal, sensed that the human bearing an ancient mission was growing. An ancient and powerful will awakened from slumber, beginning to search through the Void for the inheritor it had waited ten thousand years for.

'Interesting...' An aged yet majestic voice echoed through the Void, 'Ten thousand years, and finally someone has touched that layer again... Chen Xuan's inheritor, let this old man see if you can go further than he did.' There was a trace of anticipation in that voice, a trace of scrutiny, and even a trace of... approval?

However, the current Chen Ji did not know that an even more ancient existence was watching over him. He walked on the small path toward the Servants' Quarters, calculating his next moves in his heart. Although he had muddled through Ling Yuan's probing, it also made him realize that time was more urgent than he had imagined.

The crack in the fourth layer of the Tianji Record's seal was continuing to expand, which meant the Eye of Heavenly Dao's perception would grow stronger and stronger. He had to gain sufficient Strength before that, otherwise once that eye completely locked onto him, everything would be ruined. To gain Strength, he needed more Heavenly Fate Value, more complete cultivation techniques, and more powerful allies.

'But Ye Qing's Demonic Path mist...' Chen Ji contemplated in his heart, 'If I can reach deeper cooperation with her, perhaps I can temporarily conceal the Tianji Record's aura.' This was the only method he could think of at present—using the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path's unique cultivation technique to tear open a brief blind spot under the Eye of Heavenly Dao's gaze.

However, was there also a connection between the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path and the Eye of Heavenly Dao? What was Ye Qing's true purpose? Could she be trusted? These were all unknown quantities. Chen Ji knew that before completely confirming, he must not bet all his trump cards on an uncertain ally.

'It seems... I need to meet her in person.' Chen Ji made his decision. With his current Strength, showing some of his trump cards before Ye Qing should be manageable. More importantly, he needed to personally confirm the relationship between the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path and the Eye of Heavenly Dao to make more accurate judgments.

Just then, a familiar aura drifted over from nearby. Chen Ji looked up to see Su Qingyao standing at the crossroads ahead, looking at him with a half-smile. Her eyes carried a trace of inquiry, a trace of doubt, and a trace of... indescribable emotion.

dialogue.content: 'Chen Ji disciple brother, where are you going so early?' Su Qingyao's voice was cold as frost, yet carried an undercurrent of subtle probing, 'The matter in the Council Hall yesterday—you truly made people... look at you with new eyes.' Her gaze was like a blade, trying to pierce through Chen Ji's facade oftrash.

text.content: Chen Ji's heart tightened, but his expression showed nothing. He slightly bowed, his posture respectful as a true Servant Disciple would be: 'Senior Sister Su is too kind. This junior only happened to have a breakthrough at a critical moment due to good luck. How could I possibly deserve the words 'look at with new eyes'.' His tone was humble, yet a sharp light only he could perceive flickered in his eyes.

Su Qingyao walked closer, reducing the distance between them to just three feet. This was her usual probing technique—observing the other party's micro-expressions and micro-movements at close range to find flaws. Yet Chen Ji stood there, posture still humble, eyes still fearful, as if the person who had made Han Lie retreat three steps yesterday was not him at all.

dialogue.content: 'Is that so?' Su Qingyao's voice carried a playful note, 'Then can this senior sister ask, how exactly did you manage it? A breakthrough to mid-Transformation God stage is never achieved overnight. And you...' Her gaze swept over Chen Ji, 'Your secrets are probably more than anyone else's.'

text.content: Chen Ji's heartbeat slightly quickened, yet his expression remained unchanged. Su Qingyao's intuition was indeed sharp—she was truly among the best of the Inner Disciple Senior Fellows. Three times now, she had gotten infinitely close to the truth—but each time, he had skillfully resolved it. This time, he had to be even more careful.

dialogue.content: 'Senior Sister overpraises me.' Chen Ji forced a bitter smile, his tone carrying just the right amount of helplessness, 'This junior only happened to obtain a thousand-year spiritual reishi mushroom, and after taking it, fortunately broke through by chance. If there's any secret in this... it's probably that this junior has pretty good luck.' As he spoke, he did not forget to show a self-deprecating smile.

text.content: Su Qingyao's brow slightly furrowed. She knew Chen Ji was lying, yet could find no evidence. His expression, tone, micro-movements were all flawless, not a single flaw to be found. This man... just how did he manage that? A strong curiosity surged in her heart, along with a trace of... indescribable emotion.

dialogue.content: 'A thousand-year spiritual reishi mushroom?' Su Qingyao coldly laughed, 'Do you take this senior sister for a three-year-old? Within a hundred li of the Tianqing Sect, there is absolutely no environment suitable for a thousand-year spiritual reishi mushroom to grow. Such a low-quality lie, you think I would believe it?' Her tone grew colder and colder, her gaze sharper and sharper.

text.content: Chen Ji sighed in his heart. Su Qingyao was indeed not easy to deceive—her wisdom and intuition far surpassed ordinary people, making her the most troublesome investigator Chen Ji had ever encountered. If it weren't for the existence of the Tianji Record, he might have considered revealing part of the truth to her. But now... it wasn't the right time.

dialogue.content: "Since senior sister doesn't believe, then junior brother has nothing more to say." Chen Ji spread open his hands, adopting an innocent posture. "If senior sister doesn't believe, feel free to investigate. See whether junior brother has had any opportunity over these years to come into contact with any precious spiritual medicines." His tone was calm, as if truly having a clear conscience.

text.content: Su Qingyao fell silent for a moment, then suddenly stepped forward, closing the distance between them to less than a chi. Their breaths nearly intertwined, her gaze like a sharp blade piercing directly into Chen Ji's eyes. "Chen Ji, I'm warning you—" Her voice was low and dangerous. "Whatever you're hiding, I will find out."

Chen Ji sensed the faint fragrance emanating from Su Qingyao, yet his heart held no impure thoughts. He met her gaze directly, and a faint smile suddenly curved his lips. "Senior sister may investigate as she wishes." His voice was calm, yet carried a strange certainty. "But junior brother advises senior sister—some truths, once known, will only lead one into greater danger."

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao's pupils slightly contracted. "Are you threatening me?" Her voice carried a hint of anger. "Chen Ji, who do you think you are? A mere servant disciple, daring to lecture me—"
